from collections import Counter

def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    row_modes = [Counter(row).most_common(1)[0][0] for row in grid]
    col_modes = [Counter(grid[r][c] for r in range(h)).most_common(1)[0][0] for c in range(w)]
    def regular(indices):
        if len(indices) < 2:
            return False
        gaps = [b-a for a,b in zip(indices, indices[1:])]
        return len(set(gaps)) == 1
    candidates=[]
    for color in set(row_modes) & set(col_modes):
        rs=[i for i,x in enumerate(row_modes) if x==color]
        cs=[i for i,x in enumerate(col_modes) if x==color]
        if regular(rs) and regular(cs):
            candidates.append((len(rs)*len(cs), min(len(rs),len(cs)), color, rs, cs))
    if not candidates:
        raise ValueError('no regular line color')
    _,_,line_color,all_rs,all_cs=max(candidates)
    active_rs=[r for r in all_rs if any(grid[r][c] != line_color for c in all_cs)]
    active_cs=[c for c in all_cs if any(grid[r][c] != line_color for r in all_rs)]
    rs=[r for r in all_rs if active_rs and min(active_rs)<=r<=max(active_rs)]
    cs=[c for c in all_cs if active_cs and min(active_cs)<=c<=max(active_cs)]
    if len(rs)<2 or len(cs)<2: raise ValueError('insufficient active separators')
    counts=Counter(v for row in grid for v in row if v != line_color)
    fill=counts.most_common(1)[0][0]
    out=[]
    for r0,r1 in zip(rs,rs[1:]):
        row=[]
        for c0,c1 in zip(cs,cs[1:]):
            corners=(grid[r0][c0],grid[r0][c1],grid[r1][c0],grid[r1][c1])
            row.append(corners[0] if corners.count(corners[0])==4 and corners[0]!=line_color else fill)
        out.append(row)
    return out

program='''from collections import Counter


def transform(grid):
    height, width = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    row_modes = [Counter(row).most_common(1)[0][0] for row in grid]
    col_modes = [Counter(grid[r][c] for r in range(height)).most_common(1)[0][0] for c in range(width)]

    def regularly_spaced(indices):
        if len(indices) < 2:
            return False
        gaps = [b - a for a, b in zip(indices, indices[1:])]
        return len(set(gaps)) == 1

    candidates = []
    for color in set(row_modes) & set(col_modes):
        rows = [r for r, value in enumerate(row_modes) if value == color]
        cols = [c for c, value in enumerate(col_modes) if value == color]
        if regularly_spaced(rows) and regularly_spaced(cols):
            candidates.append((len(rows) * len(cols), min(len(rows), len(cols)), color, rows, cols))
    if not candidates:
        raise ValueError("Could not identify the regular grid-line color")

    _, _, line_color, all_rows, all_cols = max(candidates)
    active_rows = [r for r in all_rows if any(grid[r][c] != line_color for c in all_cols)]
    active_cols = [c for c in all_cols if any(grid[r][c] != line_color for r in all_rows)]
    rows = [r for r in all_rows if active_rows and min(active_rows) <= r <= max(active_rows)]
    cols = [c for c in all_cols if active_cols and min(active_cols) <= c <= max(active_cols)]

    fill_color = Counter(value for row in grid for value in row if value != line_color).most_common(1)[0][0]
    output = []
    for r0, r1 in zip(rows, rows[1:]):
        output_row = []
        for c0, c1 in zip(cols, cols[1:]):
            corners = (grid[r0][c0], grid[r0][c1], grid[r1][c0], grid[r1][c1])
            if corners[0] != line_color and all(value == corners[0] for value in corners):
                output_row.append(corners[0])
            else:
                output_row.append(fill_color)
        output.append(output_row)
    return output
'''
